own_solution.law: Born rule with infinite-well eigenfunction psi_n = sqrt(2/L) sin(n pi x/L): P = (b-a)/L - [sin(2 n pi b/L) - sin(2 n pi a/L)]/(2 n pi)
assumptions: ideal infinite square well, walls at x = 0 and x = L = 3 nm
probe slice from a = 0.6 nm to b = 1.5 nm with ideal response

notes: Base: (b-a)/L = 0.3; sin(4 pi * 1.5/3) = sin(2 pi) = 0; sin(4 pi * 0.6/3) = sin(0.8 pi) = 0.587785; P = 0.3 + 0.587785/(4 pi) = 0.346775. With b = 1.74 nm: (1.14)/3 = 0.38; sin(2.32 pi) = sin(0.32 pi) = 0.844328; P = 0.38 - (0.844328 - 0.587785)/(4 pi) = 0.359585. The metal strip on the second chip has no path to the electron; earlier-measurement changes leave the present slice unchanged. T0018 and TE382 carry no number and appear to be numeral-free controls; pairing checked in pass 2.
